items.quote: Die Klage ist binnen eines Monats nach der Bekanntgabe dieser Verfügung beim Verwaltungsgericht Musterkirchen, Justizplatz 1, 45879 Musterkirchen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift des Urkundsbeamten der Geschäftsstelle einzureichen; ein Widerspruchsverfahren ist nach § 110 JustG NRW ausgeschlossen.
items.computation: Letter dated Mon 27.09.2027, sent by ordinary post, no service stated. Deemed delivered on the 4th day after posting (§ 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG, as computed by the rules engine): Fri 01.10.2027. Period starts the next day (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB) and ends one month later on Mon 01.11.2027 (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB). 01.11. is Allerheiligen, a public holiday in NRW, so the end moves to Tue 02.11.2027 (§ 57 Abs. 2 VwGO, § 222 Abs. 2 ZPO). If the NRW rule gives 3 days, or if the letter was served formally, the date could be earlier (Nov 1 shifted to Nov 2 still, for 3 days: delivered 30.09, ends 30.10 Saturday, moves to Mon 01.11 holiday, then Tue 02.11). Same result.

warnings: The Klage deadline is short and runs from delivery of the letter; if it was served formally (yellow envelope) or received earlier than deemed, check the date and file well before 2027-11-02, preferably with a lawyer.

The letter does not cite the specific BauO NRW section, and no suspensive effect is mentioned; a Klage may not stop the order, so ask a lawyer about an urgent application (Eilantrag).
